title: GN 2023-1505 Supreme and High Court Calendar 2024
text:
General Notice 1505 of 2023.
SUPREME COURT ACT [CHAPTER 7:13]
HIGH COURT ACT [CHAPTER 7:06]
	 	 	 	 	
________
	
Supreme and High Court Calendar 2024
	 	 	 	 	
________
	 IT is hereby notified that in terms of section 27 of the Supreme 
Court Act [Chapter 7:13] and section 47 of the High Court Act 
[Chapter 7:06], the sittings and vacations of the Supreme Court 
and High Court during the year 2024 shall be as specified in the 
Schedule.
          
	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	 	
HON. CHIEF JUSTICE MALABA CJ,
22-9-2023. 	
Chairperson, Judicial Service Commission.
Schedule
COURT CALENDAR 2024
SUPREME COURT CALENDAR 2024
First Term: 8th January, 2024 to 28th March, 2024
Easter Vacation: 29th March, 2024 to 5th May, 2024
Second Term: 6th May, 2024 to 26th July, 2024
Mid-Year-Year Vacation: 27th July, 2024 to 8th September, 2024
Third Term: 9th September, 2024 to 29th November, 2024
Christmas Vacation: 30th November, 2024 to 13th January, 2025
SUPREME COURT CIRCUIT 2024
First Circuit
Bulawayo: 18th March, 2024 to 22nd March, 2024 
Second Circuit
Bulawayo: 15th July, 2024 to 19th July, 2024
Third Circuit
Bulawayo: 18th November, 2024 to 22nd November, 2024
HIGH COURT CALENDAR 2024
First Term: 8th January, 2024 to 28th March, 2024
Easter Vacation: 29th March, 2024 to 5th May, 2024
Second Term: 6th May, 2024 to 26th July, 2024
Mid-Year-Year Vacation: 27th July, 2024 to 8th September, 2024
Third Term: 9th September, 2024 to 29th November, 2024
Christmas Vacation: 30th November, 2024 to 13th January, 2025
HIGH COURT CIRCUITS 2024
First Circuit
Gweru: 22nd January, 2024 to 2nd February, 2024
Hwange: 4th March, 2024 to 15th March, 2024 
Second Circuit
Gweru: 13th May, 2024 to 24th May, 2024 
Hwange: 24th June, 2024 to 5th July, 2024
Third Circuit
Gweru: 16th September, 2024 to 27th September, 2024
Hwange: 7th October, 2024 to 18th October, 2024
